ITEM 1 | Bright green broccoli florets, several small clusters with dense tree-like tops and pale green stems, slightly glossy and firm-looking, arranged on the upper left of the plate; cluster footprint roughly 9 cm by 8 cm, about 3 cm tall | 85
ITEM 2 | Roasted or baked chicken piece with golden-brown, slightly crisp skin and visible pale flesh with stringy texture at the cut edge, roughly triangular, about 8 cm by 5 cm and 2.5 cm thick, sitting beside the lentils | 130
ITEM 3 | Cooked brown lentils, dark brown-olive small granules, slightly moist and matte, forming a loose mound about 6 cm by 4 cm and 1.5 cm high, tucked between the chicken and the potato bake | 70
ITEM 4 | Sliced potato bake layer with thin overlapping golden-yellow potato slices, edges browned and slightly crisp, bound with a creamy pale sauce, on a tomato-red base, rectangular wedge about 9 cm by 6 cm and 2 cm thick, lower right of the plate | 120
ITEM 5 | Tomato-based red sauce, glossy and smooth, visible as a red streak and pool among the potato slices and under the bake, thin layer about 0.3 cm thick, covering roughly 20 square cm | 15
